exceptions.reason: Accepted risk renewed 1 November 2026; review by 31 January 2027. private, versioned Terraform state for Demo infrastructure uses SSE-S3 (AES256); a customer-managed KMS key adds cost and operations outside this release.
Accepted risk renewed 1 November 2026; review by 31 January 2027. private, versioned hosted dev backups use SSE-S3 (AES256); a customer-managed KMS key adds cost and operations outside this release.

Accepted risk renewed 1 November 2026; review by 31 January 2027. CloudTrail writes to a private, versioned SSE-S3 (AES256) log bucket for hosted dev; a customer-managed KMS key adds cost and operations outside this release.

Accepted risk renewed 1 November 2026; review by 31 January 2027. the private, versioned dev and release media buckets (media root, reused by release as module.media) use SSE-S3 (AES256), which meets the encryption-at-rest requirement; a customer-managed KMS key adds cost and needs KMS rights the apply role does not have.

Accepted risk renewed 1 November 2026; review by 31 January 2027. the release CloudFront distribution matches the dev distribution (HTTPS redirect, no caching of private API responses, origin secret header) without AWS WAF; a web ACL adds monthly cost outside this academic deployment.

Accepted risk renewed 1 November 2026; review by 31 January 2027. Release #504 uses the existing accepted hosted-backup encryption choice: this private, versioned release-only bucket uses SSE-S3 (AES256). It has public access blocked and denies insecure transport. As with dev backups and release media, a customer-managed KMS key adds cost and requires KMS rights the apply role does not have. This exception accepts only that encryption finding, not access or isolation failures.
